name: Jordan Kemper
title: Consultant & Speaker
review: Daniel is the most professional and thoughtful businessman I've ever met. He is always on time, always over-delivers, and puts his clients' needs above his own. You can expect world class service and products from Daniel.

name: Dan Sorey
title: Partner at Sorey & Hoover, L.L.P.; Board Certified Personal Injury Trial Lawyer
review: Daniel is knowledgeable and patient, especially for someone who hates shopping! Nothing easier than having him drop by your office, show you options and place an order. Great guy! Thanks Daniel.

name: Craig Hobson
title: Website Consultant & Strategist
review:
Instead of writing a little fluff I was going to point out a few reasons why you may not want to hire daniel. I couldn't think of anything. Well, he's tall. And I'm always a little jealous that he is always so well dressed.

Daniel Wiebracht is premium value, extremely likable, and hands down one of my favorite people. Hire him. You'll be glad you did.

name: Daniel Waitzman
title: Shareholder at Hughes Socol Piers Resnick & Dym, Ltd.
review: Daniel worked very hard to obtain my business over the course of a year or two and I’m glad he did. While Daniel sold himself to me, it was the custom suit he delivered a few weeks later that sold me on his services. The best part is I never had to leave my office to go shopping. Daniel brought his vast knowledge of clothing and passionate interest in my clothing needs to each of our meetings. I wish him the best of luck in Texas with his new family and business.

name: Brendan Burke
title: Director at Global Economics Group, Certified Personal Trainer
review: Daniel was very helpful to me in choosing great looking, well made clothes by Tom James. I'm happy to recommend his work to anyone.

name: Chris Krahe
title: Managing Director, Chief of Staff to the CEO at S&P Global
review: Daniel provides excellent customer service and expertise. I was very satisfied with all my custom clothing purchases from Tom James while working with Daniel.

name: Colin McRoberts
title: Congressional Candidate for the Kansas First District
review: Daniel is a talented and dedicated clothier; I relied on his taste and recommendations for years. I also quickly learned that I could rely on his punctuality and dedication; he stands by his work and his firm's work. I would still be a regular client if he were still a regular Chicago resident. As it is, he is the first person I will turn to with special or difficult requests.

name: Michael Chu
title: Partner at McDermott Will & Emery
review: Daniel is a top-notch representative over at Tom James, and I have been very pleased with his approach and expertise. What I most appreciate is his understanding of the time constraints on a busy client. He is not a high-pressure salesman (which is a huge turnoff for so many of us) but rather a very knowledgeable consultant who can help you make decisions on what works and what doesn't. His clothing line is very good, reasonably priced, and it changes often. I recommend Daniel very highly.

name: Michael Lindberg CFP®, CLU®
title: Founder and Private Wealth Management Advisor at Four Oak Financial
review: Daniel is a great guy who is passionate about what he does. He is flexible and accomodating to my busy schedule and is someone I will be using for a long time due to his knowledge of the industry. I appreciate all the work Daniel does for me and would highly recommend him to anyone interested in looking their best personally or professionally on a daily basis

name: Devlin Schoop
title: Circuit Judge, Circuit Court of Cook County
review: I've bought several suits and ties from Daniel. Always satisfied with the product and service. Thanks, Dan!

name: Peter Nabicht
title: Maker. Gettin' stuff done at Hive Trading.
review: Daniel is fantastic at what he does. Since I've started using him I've never once had to think twice about my clothing. He will make great suggestions, execute what I want, and make sure that every detail is correct. I'll never go store bought again.

name: James McGovern, CPA/CFF, CVA
title: Forensic Accountant and Economic Damages Expert
review: Daniel is a excellent clothier. He will come to your office and outfit you with all your clothing needs. He is very customer oriented and will respect your time. If you are looking for great suits or other clothing and hate to shop, let Daniel do the work for you.

name: Dean Marinakis
title: Attorney at Law
review: Daniel is a pleasure to work with and goes the extra mile to ensure that his clients are happy and pleased with their purchases.

name: Mike Cherry
title: R. Lacy, Longview, TX
review: I have just moved to Longview about a year ago, and I have had the privilege of meeting Daniel Wiebracht at Tom James and have since purchased a suit and several sports jackets and other items through Daniel this past year. I have been very impressed with the high end quality of the merchandise and the excellent service that comes with each order. I have a very busy schedule and I hate with a passion to go into various stores to try and update my wardrobe. With Tom James, Daniel comes to me at my office, at a time that is convenient for me, and with the very first visit he records all of my measurements to allow me to spend a very short amount of time to quickly pick out what I want and need, then several weeks later Daniel shows up with custom made clothes for a reasonable price and absolutely no hassle on my part. Very high end quality and service, for custom made merchandise, for a very reasonable cost with the utmost of convenience! That's Daniel Wiebracht & Tom James.

name: Stephen Higdon
title: US District Court, Tyler, TX
review: Working with Daniel has been an absolute pleasure. He accommodates not just a busy schedule, but also works diligently to ensure that you are happy with your garment. He asked all the right questions to figure out what mattered to me. As a result, the final products have exceeded my very high expectations.

name: Reed Rippy
title: Rippy Oil, Tyler, TX
review: This is the first time I've used Daniel's services, but not Tom James, and was very impressed. Daniel was professional and pleasant. He fitted me and my son, and the pants and shirts came back when he said they would. My son lives out of state, and he received everything in fine order. Daniel was also very flexible as far as setting up a time and place to meet. Next time I need new clothes, I would definitely use Daniel and Tom James again.

name: John Mark Coburn
title: Attorney, Mt Pleasant, TX
review: Daniel Wiebracht has done a great job! He has great taste and understands customer service. I highly recommend him.

name: Richard Lawrence
title: Bryce’s Cafeteria, Texarkana, TX
review: Just a note about Daniel Wiebracht...Daniel has been selling me cloths from Tom James for several years. I very much like his style and his patients with me. If I don't like something that he has shown me or something that I have bought that does not fit me right, Daniel is very understanding and gets things right. I think he is a great sales person and handles himself in a professional manner. I know Tom James should be very proud to have someone like Daniel that represents their company.

name: Duane Gaulden
title: Select Insurance Group, Greenville, TX
review: I found Daniel's customer service to be prompt, courteous and friendly. He has bent over backward to make sure we were satisfied with our order.

name: Cole Tomberlain
title: Tomberlain Insurance, Longview, TX
review: First impressions are everything in business, and separating yourself from your competitors before you even open your mouth for an introduction is key. Daniel Wiebracht allows my success in my business to be reflected through my attire. Sharp suits that are tailored to fit my body perfectly allow me to feel comfortable and confident. Whether I am in the office or at a business after hours, I am constantly receiving compliments on the subtle flair that sets the suits apart. From monogrammed cuffs with my signature to ticket pockets and suspenders, Daniel Wiebracht does an incredible job of helping me look professional and unique.

name: Wes Hill
title: Attorney, Longview, TX
review: Daniel is a patient guy focused on getting you what you want and making sure it looks like you want it to look.

name: Linda Smith
title: Attorney, Bossier City, LA
review: Daniel provides excellent service with the follow-up care that is appreciated in order to make certain your clothing purchases meet your expectations. He understands his customers and puts their needs first. As a female professional I appreciate his willingness to serve this niche market when few others will or can do so.

name: Chad Morgan
title: Morgan Insurance, Lufkin, TX
review: Daniel has been a trusted person for me for my clothing needs. His personal service is very much appreciated and it helps me greatly when I need to make some clothing decisions. His professionalism, knowledge, and personal service are very much appreciated and I would highly recommend him to my friends and colleagues. Keep up the good work!

name: Dr. Mark Littlejohn
title: Otolaryngologist, Longview, TX
review: Because of my shorter stature, both my pants and shirts have to be custom made for a correct fit. I was introduced to Tom James through Daniel Wiebracht, our area "bespoke" clothier. His professionalism has been a joy to work with, and the tailoring is impeccable. I find his advice to be current and his selection of fabrics to be essential to the well dressed man. He is conscientious and I can recommend both him and Tom James without reservation.

name: Ron Hutchison
title: Network IP, Longview, TX
review: Daniel, I am very happy with the attention and response I receive from you. The quality, fit and style of the clothes elevates my appearance and confidence as I meet with people to explore business ideas and opportunities.

name: Judge T. John Ward
title: Longview, TX
review: Daniel Wiebracht with Tom James is my go to guy when buying the best of the best. His service is always great.

name: Paul Boyd
title: Attorney, Tyler, TX
review: I have found Daniel to be very helpful. He has gone the second mile to try and help and always been responsive to my concerns. I can certainly recommend Daniel for your clothing needs.

name: Jerry Rawlinson
title: Amega Tool Works, Longview, TX
review: Daniel, you did me a great job! You were very helpful in the selection of colors as well making sure everything fit. It was good doing business you and I’m sure I will see you again.

name: Andrew Spangler
title: Attorney, Longview, TX
review: The quality of my Tom James clothing combined with the commitment Daniel has to making sure I am happy with anything I buy from him makes my wardrobe hassle free. I would recommend Daniel and Tom James to anyone looking to get a better value out of their clothing budget while spending much less time shopping.

name: Jamey Walker
title: R. Lacy, Longview, TX
review:
I have been really pleased with the custom made shirts and suit purchased from Daniel and Tom James. Daniel is very professional and pays close attention to detail to make sure the clothes are a perfect fit and match my taste in style and design. I couldn't be more pleased with the feel and look of the clothing.

I haven't had much success with personal tailors in the past, but my experience with Daniel has been great. He's attentive to my needs, as necessary, and provides great advice on my clothing and wardrobe. Additionally, he tailors my clothing to fit the way I like my clothing to fit. It's my pleasure to recommend Daniel to help with your clothing needs. I think he will do a great job for you.

name: Scott Stevens
title: Attorney
review: I truly enjoy working with Daniel. He provides me excellent customer service, and the clothing is wonderful.

name: Carson Runge
title: Attorney
review: I have enjoyed giving my business to Daniel Wiebracht over the last few years. Daniel brought the Tom James 'store' and his expertise to me, at a time that was convenient for me and ensured that the final product fit me correctly. Daniel always promptly responds to any questions or concerns that I may have. I highly recommend Daniel.

name: Todd Tefteller
title: Attorney
review: Daniel Wiebracht is a bright young man who knows what kind of tastes his clients have. He always followed up at the right times too. Very knowledgeable of men's dress attire.

name: Gary Boyd
title: County Commissioner
review: A pleasure to give you thumbs up for the service you've given me here in East Texas.

name: Guy Harrison
title: Attorney
review: Thank you for the service you have provided me on behalf of the Tom James Company. I have always found the company, and especially you as their latest representative, to be open and prepared to answer any of my concerns, and very helpful in my personal clothing needs. Thanks for your help.

name: Andrei Gasic
title: Gastroenterologist
review: Daniel with Tom James provides an exceptional wardrobe that spans from casual to elegant. The fit and workmanship is extraordinary. Daniel goes the extra mile to satisfy his customers. He takes ownership of any problems that may arise. He is focused on achieving high customer satisfaction while at the same time delivering a product that is fairly priced. I expect that even the most discriminating client will be happy with the attention to detail Daniel provides.

name: Johnny Ward
title: Attorney
review: I have been doing business with the Tom James Co. for over seven years, and going on three years now with Daniel. The professionalism, quality, selection and convenience of shopping in the privacy of my office are simply unsurpassed. I appreciate the fact that my Daniel knows my fit, style preferences and wardrobe when suggesting other clothing. He's always considerate of my time, and appreciative of the fact that quality clothing can last for many years so he's not constantly calling on me to make a purchase.

name: Benton Ross
title: Attorney
review: When I moved to East Texas, I was a 'blue jeans and boots' kind of guy. But as my new job required me to see more and more clients, I needed to look better. Daniel not only got me into custom-fitted clothes at great price, he assisted me in crafting the professional look I wanted to project for my clients. Knowledgeable in the current movements and trends in style, Daniel has been able to make me look sharp while maintaining a professional appearance. When the people in the office tell me how nice I look, I know Daniel is doing a great job!

name: Michael Runyan
title: Attorney
review: Working with Daniel has been a pleasure. He is prompt, efficient, and my custom tailored clothes have arrived just as ordered. Having clothes that are custom sized for me is second to none, and surprisingly comparable to what you would pay for comparable off the rack clothes. I would highly recommend Daniel and Tom James to anyone looking for their business causal and better clothing needs.

name: Ryan Hamilton
title: Guarantee Bond Bank
review: My experience with Tom James has been exceptional. The clothing is well made and the fitting process is easy and accurate. Daniel is always attentive to my requests and provides the level of service you would expect from a custom clothier.

name: John Bolster
title: Attorney
review: Great fitting clothes with quality workmanship! Daniel provides top-notch customer service as well.

name: Andy Khoury
title: Attorney
review: It has been a pleasure working with Daniel. He is a true professional and pays attention to the smallest details. My satisfaction is important to him, and it shows.

name: Bruce Smith
title: Attorney
review: Daniel has done a tremendous job by providing quality clothing without the hassle of leaving my office. He is great with follow up and taking care of any alterations if things are not just perfect. I would highly recommend him to all.

name: Glenn Perry
title: Attorney
review: Daniel has done an excellent job for me. He is courteous, attentive to detail and timely. I have been very pleased with his service and his product. What more can you ask for?

name: Laura McKethan
title: Citizens National Bank
review: When I first met Daniel, I was immediately struck by his sense of style and the fit of his clothes. I knew I was with the right company and the right guy! Once I ordered my first suit, my son immediately called Daniel to establish a relationship with him, too, because I was so pleased. We have both been very happy with the suits, shirts, blazers, ties, etc., that we have ordered and we are looking forward to a long relationship with Tom James through Daniel Wiebracht.

name: David Stanley
title: Winn Professional Engineers
review: Not only did Daniel fit me for my first custom tailored suit, he took the time to get to know me and my style; making me that much more pleased with the final product. Due to Daniel's desire to make me feel comfortable and his willingness to go the extra mile, I will continue to work with him for all my clothing necessities and readily recommend him to any person, whatever their needs may be.

name: David & Delena Dorgan
review: We were VERY pleased with the customer service from you on the items that we ordered. It was such a pleasant experience for you to come to us for our needs for David. After you delivered the suit and items that were made for him, we were even more impressed with the quality of the suits and clothing that came. It was a GREAT purchase from you and we will always call you in the future for our custom clothing needs.

name: Chase Palmer
title: Attorney
review: I could not be more pleased with Daniel and his professionalism and attention to detail. His products are top of the line and he does a great job of taking care of his clients.

name: John Ford
title: PhyNet
review: Daniel was very attentive and works hard to please the customer. He takes a genuine interest in his clients.

name: Will Adamson
title: Sabine Pipe
review: Daniel is a true professional in his approach to selling men's clothing. He makes the process very easy and ensures you receive a product that looks and fits great.

name: Mike Northcutt
title: Southside Bank
review: Daniel has been very receptive to my clothing needs. He knows the type of suits I like and he knows that ties are very important to me. My experience with Daniel has been great.

name: Mike Holbert
title: Louis Morgan
review: I have bought clothes from Daniel multiple times and have been pleased with each purchase. The clothes are very good quality and I could not be happier.

name: Charles R. Martin
title: Pulmonologist
review: I have been very pleased with the custom clothing fitted for me by Daniel. I have enjoyed excellent service and when there was a problem, he had it fixed immediately. I have several pairs of slacks which I wear almost daily to work and to church. Thanks, Daniel.

name: Chapman Bauerlein
title: Attorney
review: Daniel was referred to me by another attorney in the area and exceeded all of my expectations. He came to the office for the fitting, making the whole process more convenient. Daniel gave expert advice on the construction of a new suit for me and when it came in the suit fit perfectly.

name: Brandon Horton
review:
Daniel is the real deal. He meets you exactly with where you are at (both physically and mentally) but works to expand your knowledge of his value, clothing and style. He never sells things you are not sold on and never pushes just to make a sale.

Daniel has been in the industry many years and brings you back in time to a place where tailors were behind every successful man. He is a wonderful, thoughtful and dependable guy and will impress you on your first visit.

Men, you will never have to enter another department store again.

name: Dennis Wissing
review: I have purchased Tom James clothing for 10 years and Daniel is professional, knows his clothing, and personalizes each purchase. It has always been a good experience purchasing clothes from Daniel. Highly recommend his services.

name: Jim McClelland
review: Daniel is an engaging and knowledgeable person. The best thing about dealing with Tom James Clothing is that I don't have to leave my office to go shopping. Daniel comes right to my office and makes everything easy.

name: Beau Williams
review: Working with Daniel is a smooth process. I have been very pleased with the clothes and Daniel makes the experience great with no hassles. I would encourage anyone in the market for fine clothing to give Daniel a call!

name: John Manno Jr.
review:
I have purchased Tommy James for the last 10 years or so. I no longer do so only because I have retired. However when I do need some men's clothing I immediately call Daniel. I have also recommended clothes to some of my business acquaintance's I have and will continue to recommend Tom James and Daniel.

Thanks,
John A. Manno, Jr.

name: Pete Bratlie
review: I have done business Daniel Weibracht of Tom James for several years. He has always taken care of me with great care. From new suits or shirts to alterations after losing weight, he's a true salesman.

name: John Griffin
review: Daniel gives you great service and his product is great quality. You would do well to consider using him to help you keep your wardrobe up to date.

name: Jeff Raley
review: Daniel does a great job. Makes it all easy. If your looking for good fitting clothes call Daniel.

name: Roger Cunningham
review: Daniel Wiebracht is major league! Always striving to make sure customer satisfaction is achieved.

name: Brennan Hussey
review: Daniel Wiebracht is terrific. He provides great service to help you to look sharp.

name: Colin Evans
review: from shoes to shirts, pants to sport coats... Daniel has continued to provide amazing service and impeccable clothing!

name: Carl Cochran
review: Great product, Daniel really seems to want to help you look your best and take care of anything you may need.

name: J. Michael Mazur
review: Great service -- responsive, timely, accurate. Corrects any issues quickly.

name: Max Causey
review: Daniel’s diligence and service is unmatched.

name: Lyle Jeansonne
review: Great products, accurate fit. Great service.

name: Justin Chambers
review: Have had the pleasure of working with Daniel. Purchased two new suits that I plan on wearing for a very long time. Daniel was fantastic. He showed up within days of me requesting to meet and look over suits, and it might have even been earlier than that. Also, he is extremely helpful in the selection process and will be brutally honest, which is exactly what you want out of someone in this position. I would suggest Daniel and Tom James to anyone looking for custom suits!

name: Cullen Hopkins
review: I have purchased a number of products from tailored clothing to ready-to-wear shirts and have been pleased with all of them. Daniel takes care to ensure I’m satisfied with my purchases and is very knowledgeable in his profession. Would highly recommend!

name: jccurry11
review: I highly recommend Wardrobe by Wiebracht! I've never experienced such detailed personal service. Daniel is a professional who loves his craft and is willing to go the extra mile for his customers. Tom James Clothing for Men

name: Charles Rader
review: Daniel is great to work with. Always professional, very knowledgeable and never pushy trying to make a sale. I appreciate his laid back personality. I have purchased suits and many shirts and love them all. Quality is unmatched by store bought clothes.

name: Jeff Fair
review: Daniel, and the artisans behind the scenes, do a great job. Tom James has a great selection of fabrics, offers a wide range of style options and delivers a quality product. Daniel is more than happy to work around my schedule and sit patiently while I stare at swatches.

name: Troy Tiemann
review: Daniel was referred to me by a business colleague. I didnt know I was in the need of his services but after a few short years my closet has more Tom James than not! He is very very knowledgeable in his craft and most importantly a very likable guy. In my sales experience past I was always trained to do business with people you would be friends with anyway. I have to say that Daniel is someone I would have over anytime outside of the business arena. He is punctual, very helpful, and most of all...not a high pressure salesman. I can honestly say that I do enjoy the Tom James collection but I buy it because of Daniel.

name: Ryan Berry
review: I've been a client for many years now and have always received excellent, personalized customer service from Daniel. My custom, Tom James suits and shirts not only look and fit great, but also are well built and long lasting. I am still wearing many of the same clothes I got in my first order!

name: Steve Jones
review:
Very much enjoy working with Daniel for my ongoing professional wardrobe needs.

When I need to show up looking my best I’m always confident when Daniel has me covered (literally). Also appreciate his consistent & regular follow up to make sure all the items he supplies are “just right” in regard fit and finish.

I’m further impressed with his advice & assistance on items he didn’t even initially provide; I got new life out of a fine older suit that was too big after he recently had it refit for me.

Quality wardrobe is a professional investment for me that I take seriously and it’s a comfort to have Daniel helping me care for this important aspect of my working life.

name: Bradley Diggins
review: I have purchased two suits from Tom James now and I love them! The first suit took a few fittings and adjustments, but Daniel was helpful, patient and very attentive to make sure I was happy with every detail. The second suit was made perfectly with no further adjustments necessary. I highly recommend Tom James as a company but specifically Daniel Wiebracht!

name: Kelly W.
review: My suits, pants and dress shirts fit and feel so much better than department store clothing. Daniel works around my schedule whether that be at my office or home making shopping very convenient and effortless. If you lack fashion sense like me Daniels suggestions of patterns and colors will keep you looking sharp and professional. Daniel is easy and enjoyable to work with and respectful of your time. Without question 5 stars!

name: Max Causey
review: Daniel Wiebracht has been a true partner for me. I appreciate the ease and convenience of working with Daniel. Since we began our professional relationship, I haven’t shopped for a single piece of dress clothing at a store. I give him my full endorsement.

name: Mark Stanley
review: I've been buying my shirts and jackets from Daniel for maybe three plus years now. Great to work with, and always fun to chat with him for a few minutes, even if he stops by and I dont need anything. ALL of my shirts and jackets fit well, and have held up very well. It is surprising that you can get a custom tailored jacket for a basically mid-level jacket at Dillards. However, the sky is the limit if you wish.

name: James Clark
review: Prior to discovering Tom James clothing, I would purchase suits off the rack hoping they would turn out fitting OK. Now with the help of Daniel Wiebracht with Tom James, every suit fits like a glove. Daniel makes the fitting process easy and convenient by coming to my office any time I need a new suit or alteration. Daniel also makes great suggestions on which patterns best compliment my current wardrobe. Through my experience with Tom James, I cannot see myself shopping anywhere else for formal clothes.

name: Ashton Closner
review: Daniel is both knowledgeable and Professional. Highly recommend working with him and clothes are high quality to say the least. Daniel could not make the experience any more convenient.

name: Preston Rader
review: Anytime we work with Daniel he makes the process so easy and personable. Any suit or shirts I have purchased over the years have looked and fit great! I would recommend his services to anyone looking for a personalized touch when it comes to clothing.

name: Michael Smith
review: I have really appreciated Daniel's help and expertise in picking out suits and other apparel, as well as making sure what I already have still looks good. I'd recommend him highly if you're looking for professional attire in East Texas.

name: Ken Hale
review: Daniel my Tom James rep is great to work with. Knowledgeable, professional and also responds with any questions I ever have. I Would recommend Daniel & Tom James if you want quality and top notch service

name: Bill Hommel
review: As always, Daniel Wiebracht is a supremely professional clothier. Everything you could ask for in assisting a professional with his wardrobe. I could not ask for a better partner in keeping me properly dressed! 5 stars is not enough!

name: Michael Smith
review: I have been doing business with Tom James rep Daniel Wiebracht for some number of years. His service has always been prompt and professional. The product has always been good and a great convenience to the busy professional.

name: David Stein
review: My new sport coat fits like a glove. I've never purchased a custom coat before this and glad I did. Daniel Wiebracht is a true professional who knows what works. He said it would be my new favorite sport coat; he was right!

name: Casey Beddingfield
review: Recently purchased my first Tom James suite from Daniel. Great Experience! The level of attention to detail was exactly what I expected of a professional. I would highly recommend. cb

name: Kolby Beckham
review: Started ordering custom clothing a few years ago for those nicer events. I am a big broad shouldered man. Finding clothes off the rack just never seemed to end up looking just right without having to send them to be altered. Spending the money to order custom shirts has been a 100% win for me. No clothing will ever fit like these do. I highly recommend trying out a custom shirt to see the difference.

name: Will Olmstadt
review: Very pleased with Tom James in general and the service from Daniel Wiebracht specifically. I have key pieces of formal and informal clothing from them, and I rest easily knowing they are ready to go.

name: Austin G Robertson Jr
review: Daniel always conducts himself professionally. He does not waste my time. He conducts his business and is gone. I enjoy dealing with him.

name: LeAnn Sartor
review: Daniel is a true professional and extremely knowledgeable. Every suit has been perfectly tailored and of wonderful detail.

name: David Moore
review: Salesperson Daniel Wiebracht is excellent to work with. Very attentive and knowledgeable, makes the buying process easy and enjoyable

name: Steven Green
review: Daniel does a great job of helping me find awesome Tom James custom clothing. And his customer service is the best!

name: Adam P
review: I’ve been using Daniel for over 3 years, he has been nothing but professional and courteous. I would and do highly recommend him.

name: Adam Dukelow
review: Daniel is professional, attentive, and very easy to work with. I am very pleased with the clothes that I ordered through him

name: Kevin Alexander
review: Daniel is awesome to work with. Very accommodating around a hectic schedule. Quality and attention to detail are second to none!

name: Casey Robertson
review: Daniel offers great customer service and the clothes are always high quality. Definitely recommend.

name: Chase Palmer
review: I would highly recommend Daniel Wiebracht. Great guy, easy to work with and always provides a great product.

name: Major Tennison
review: Daniel Wiebracht is a pleasure to work with. Highly recommend.

name: Jeremey Bernard
review: Daniel is outstanding! The suites are amazing and well constructed.

name: Darren Grant
review: I've had great experiences with Tom James and Daniel; great customer service!

name: Jay Murrell
review: Daniel is a good man. Very satisfied.

name: Richard Traweek
review: Great service. Great clothes. Great price. Daniel is the best.

name: Danny J Cook
review: Great great products coming from great great people! Danny Cook

name: johnny moore
review: Always professional and personable with quality products

name: Security Guaranty
review: Excellent service and high quality clothing!

name: Robert Gribble
review: I could not be happier. Great fit, great look.

name: Bob Robinson
review: Very professional - was to the point and efficient.

name: Brian Bittick
review: Great Service. Great products.

name: Fred Norton, Jr.
review: AWESOME!
